author: bardic-inspiration
name: Greencheck Tavern
summary: A busy roadside tavern of five rooms, with stairs up to guest rooms and down to the cellars.
description: The Greencheck has served the crossroads for three generations, and its green-painted shutters are the first thing a traveler sees. Everyone who passes through stops here, which is why the cult is listening.

zones.name: Front Porch
zones.note: The way in, under a hanging sign painted with a green tick.

zones.name: Common Room
zones.note: Long tables, a big hearth, and a notice board crowded with work for hire.

zones.name: Bar
zones.note: A scarred oak counter; the keeper hears every rumor first.

zones.name: Stairwell
zones.note: Stairs climb to the guest rooms and drop to the cellars.
